facts.claim: The accessible playground includes rubber surfacing and wide ramps.
quote: Universally accessible playgrounds are located at: Francis RecreAcres
A rubber safety surface that allows access to all areas of the playground Multiple wide ramps for access with mobility devices

facts.claim: The park page lists an easy, one-mile shared-use loop passing the playground and soccer fields.
facts.quote: This easy loop passes soccer fields and a universally accessible playground, making it a great neighborhood route with convenient parking. ‎ Length: 1.0 Miles ‎ Type: Shared-Use ‎ Level: Easy

facts.claim: Listed amenities include parking, the playground and restrooms; restroom accessibility is not stated.
A Great Parks motor vehicle permit is required to drive into the park.
facts.quote: A valid Motor Vehicle Permit is required to enter the parks.

facts.claim: Great Parks says it will make every effort, with two weeks’ advance notice, to provide reasonable accommodations for special events and educational programs. Contact Guest Relations at 513-521-7275 (Voice/TDD); the wording is not a guarantee that every request can be met.
quote: Great Parks will make every effort, with two weeks advance notice, to provide reasonable accommodations so that people with disabilities may participate in special events and educational programs
People with disabilities needing special accommodations for the accessibility of programs should contact Guest Relations at 513-521-7275, Voice/TDD.

facts.claim: Great Parks describes bright colors and playable musical instruments among the features of its accessible playgrounds, including Francis RecreAcres. Noise and lighting levels are not measured.
quote: Universally accessible playgrounds are located at: Francis RecreAcres
An array of bright colors to increase visual stimulation and playable musical instruments to increase auditory function

facts.claim: Great Parks lists shade structures among the features of its accessible playgrounds, including Francis RecreAcres. It does not specify the amount of shade, nearby seating or year-round coverage.
quote: Universally accessible playgrounds are located at: Francis RecreAcres
Shade structures for a more enjoyable play experience

facts.claim: The park is listed as open daily from dawn until dusk. Restroom operating hours and winter availability are not specified.
facts.quote: Open daily from dawn until dusk

facts.claim: For soccer-field cancellations, the park lists 513-728-3551, extension 386. This contact is for field status, not confirmation of playground or restroom conditions.
